address: D5202, 5F, SKP Beijing, 87 Jianguo Road, Chaoyang, Beijing, China Mainland
bio: Qian Li opened in a shopping mall in 2021 to serve various Taizhou dishes at wallet-friendly prices. Fresh seafood is shipped from Taizhou daily to ensure freshness and a good variety. The must-tries include yellow croaker and fish maw thick soup that tastes briny-sweet, rich and deep. Seasonal offerings such as promfet, Bombay duck and white crab are also keenly sought after. Booth seating offers some privacy, or book one of the two private rooms....
